Confidence Score: 5/5

**[Medium impact]** The PR appears safe to merge; no actionable defects were found.

Summary

PyTorch now rebuilds EP handles from `handle_mem` instead of looking them up by address. - PyTorch EP steps rebuild handles from routing state. - EP callers can run without a handle cache by default.

Diagram

```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart LR A[PyTorch forward] --> B[Prepare routing in handle_mem] B --> C[Import handle with layer settings] C --> D[Dispatch or combine] A --> E[Save layer settings for backward] E --> F[Backward imports handle] B --> F ``` Reviews (4) · Last reviewed commit: ["Merge branch 'main' into ep\_pyt\_no\_handl..."](https://github.com/nvidia/transformerengine/commit/6921b57003e2a02e1aafe8a41228bbd6a18267aa) · [Reviewed by Greptile](https://www.greptile.com/?utm_source=greptile_review&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=review_public&utm_content=nvidia/transformerengine)

@phu0ngng Could you update the description to tag issue #3742. Thanks!
Pipeline passed for related tests, thus safe to merge.
